prompts.rock_nodes: Use case: stylized-concept. Original GAME PIXEL ART sprite sheet of mineable limestone rock nodes for Whistle Ranch. Transparent RGBA background, exactly 3 ROWS and 4 COLUMNS, equal spaced cells, no labels. Reference1 is existing ranch pixel style/palette. Reference2 is existing connected rock wall for color and light only, do not copy its sheet or flat block silhouette. Three different same-family rock shapes: TOP ROW a small squat angular single stone; MIDDLE ROW a medium irregular two-lobed rock; BOTTOM ROW a large broad angular boulder with a slightly flat top, still a one-tile deposit. Across each row show EXACT SAME rock progressively mined: column1 INTACT; column2 small freshly chipped wedge removed from lower-right side; column3 a substantially broken side and lowered silhouette, about60% original body remaining; column4 just a low jagged remnant, about30% original body remaining, just before depletion. Each row's rock must retain matching identity, camera, ground baseline, colors and proportional scale across the four stages. Actually remove volumes, do not just paint cracks. No floating bits or dust, rubble will be separate. Bright subdued warm grey/limestone, cream upper-left light, olive grey shaded fronts, clear big planar faces, few dark natural clefts. Orthographic slightly overhead ranch view, NOT isometric diamonds. Hard chunky pixels, no outlines in pure black, no fine grain, no texture noise, no realism or blurry edges, no cast ground shadow. Final native sizes roughly small22x18 medium34x27 large44x36, so broad readable shapes are essential. No grass pads, no jewels, no metal ore, no new resource types, no characters or text. This sheet supplies discrete game objects, not a scenic painting.
prompts.log_branch: Use case: stylized-concept. TWO original separated pixel-art forestry debris assets on a transparent background, one horizontal row with generous gutter. Match the supplied ranch's existing brown-barked trees and wood bundle, top-left sunlight and slightly overhead orthographic viewpoint. LEFT: one short felled log lying diagonally almost horizontally, brown rough bark, a warm cream cut end with 2 simple tree rings, NO axe, NO grass base, NO ground shadow. Native intended footprint roughly32x16 pixels. RIGHT: a loose small fallen branch with 3 broken twigs and a FEW muted green-brown leaves, irregular arrangement, gaps between twigs, not a bush or whole tree. Native intended size about32x20 pixels. Bright rustic welcoming pastoral pixel game, concise hard pixel clusters, reduced detail readable at native size, limited palette, no photorealism, no blur, no shadows, no letters or labels, no tool icons. These are removable aftermath parts, not a full scene, not new intact trees.
